evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The requirement of a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security and stability — keeping deploys safe and controlled.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by past security failures frames the motive as preventing recurrence — conservation of safety and stability.
The gate specification restates a security requirement as a binding rule — conservation of deploy integrity.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production broadens the conservation boundary — security coverage across all deploy environments.
Claiming ownership of the gate positions the speaker as accountable authority — achievement and standing as the appealed-to good.
